notes: Seven distinct movable-part episodes are visible. Open states are treated as on and closed states as off. Paired closet panels are reported separately; their closely spaced closure ordering is somewhat ambiguous because of viewpoint changes and the 8-frame sampling interval.
scene_description: A fisheye first-person traversal of an apartment entry hall, coat closet, stacked-laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user sequentially opens and closes two coat-closet panels, two laundry-closet panels, a refrigerator door, an upper spice-cabinet door, and a utensil drawer.
